data.description:
## Description

**What**: Implement plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/prompts/strata/arch-enforcement.md (silent). Appends Rails-Strata footguns from shared defaults to .claude/ARCH_ENFORCEMENT.md when framework:strata-rails is in stack array. Footgun idempotency keys on stable HTML-comment markers (e.g., `<!-- strata-footgun:rails:no-action-controller-api -->`), NOT raw rule text. Semantic overlap check before append: grep for keywords (e.g., ActionController::API, belongs_to :case); if found, emit `[A2 WARN] potential conflict: existing rule may overlap with Strata footgun '<title>'; review ARCH_ENFORCEMENT.md` and skip that footgun.
**Why**: Footguns are the production-incident knowledge captured in shared defaults; idempotency must survive re-runs and rule rewording.
**Scope**:
- IN: Sub-file with append logic; HTML-comment markers as idempotency keys; semantic-overlap keyword grep + WARN + skip behavior; only fires when framework:strata-rails detected.
- OUT: NextJS/Flask footguns (out per epic v1).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, all 5 Rails-Strata footguns are appended on first run when framework:strata-rails detected ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, re-run produces zero diff (HTML-comment marker idempotency) ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, when a keyword overlap is detected, the footgun is skipped with the named WARN ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, no Strata-related writes occur on non-Strata projects ← Satisfies: SC5
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for marker-based idempotency, overlap detection, and non-Rails-Strata skip

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Markers chosen as STABLE identifiers; rule text may be rewritten without breaking idempotency
- [Reliability] Overlap WARN never aborts onboarding — emits and continues

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an onboarding consumer, arch-enforcement.md appends Rails-Strata footguns idempotently with semantic-overlap warning
